title: 1838 Mormon War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1838 Mormon War", at revision 1381821095, opens: "The 1838 Mormon War was a period of civil unrest in northern Missouri during the summer and fall of 1838, beginning with local vigilante clashes, and concluding with the state-mandated expulsion or extermination of Mormons from the state." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2572004, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "conflict in Latter Day Saint history". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
